objective: Test operating effectiveness of PO approval controls for purchases >= $10,000
procedure_performed: Selected 30 POs >= $10,000; verified each carried manual approval by an authorized approver within the delegation-of-authority matrix
conclusion: One deviation identified: PO-2024-0188 ($11,200) was auto-approved without manual sign-off. Deviation rate 1/30 (3.3%), within tolerable rate of 5%.
recurring_finding: Auto-approval bypass for amounts near the $10,000 threshold has been noted in FY2023 as well. Recommend system control hardening.

objective: Test segregation of duties — no single individual both requests and approves a purchase
procedure_performed: Tested full population of 142 purchase transactions for requestor/approver overlap
conclusion: No deviations identified. Every transaction had a distinct requestor and approver.

objective: Substantive test of AP — vouch sample of payments to supporting documentation
procedure_performed: Selected 25 AP disbursements via monetary-unit sampling; vouched each to purchase order, receiving report, and vendor invoice
conclusion: Two items lacked a receiving report on file. Amounts immaterial ($1,400 and $3,200). No duplicate payments detected.
recurring_finding: Missing receiving reports were also flagged in FY2023. Root cause: manual process for low-value goods receipts.

objective: Test journal entry review controls — all manual JEs reviewed by a second preparer
procedure_performed: Tested 50 manual journal entries for evidence of independent review (sign-off or system log)
conclusion: No deviations. All entries carried independent reviewer sign-off within 2 business days of posting.

objective: Vendor onboarding — verify new vendors approved per policy before first payment
procedure_performed: Identified 8 vendors onboarded during FY2024; verified each had a completed vendor approval form, W-9, and banking verification before first disbursement
conclusion: No deviations. All vendors properly onboarded.

objective: Test delegation-of-authority limits — approvals within authorized dollar thresholds
procedure_performed: For 30 POs tested in WP-2024-001, cross-referenced approver to authority matrix; verified amount did not exceed approver's limit
conclusion: No deviations. All approvers acted within their delegated authority limits.

objective: Duplicate payment detection — scan full AP population for duplicate invoice numbers or amounts to same vendor within 30 days
procedure_performed: Ran automated duplicate-detection script across 980 AP disbursements; flagged potential duplicates for manual review
conclusion: Three potential duplicates flagged; all three confirmed as legitimate separate invoices upon review of supporting documentation. No actual duplicate payments.

objective: Test PO approval controls for purchases >= $10,000
procedure_performed: Selected 25 POs >= $10,000; verified manual approval and authority limits
conclusion: One auto-approval bypass identified (PO-2023-0042, $10,500). Deviation rate 1/25 (4.0%).
recurring_finding: Same root cause as current year — system auto-approval threshold not enforced for amounts near the boundary. Now a recurring finding across two periods.
